# ADR-3059: A05: Documented temporary debug session for incident 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Live debug can be necessary during SEVs.

## Decision

Responders MAY adopt a documented temporary debug session for incident 11 (A05-11) when diagnosing production faults.

## Consequences

Sessions auto-expire and are audited.
